    The radical of a preadditive category #

    This file defines the standard Jacobson-radical condition for a morphism in a preadditive category and proves a one-generator cosemisimplicity criterion. If every object is a finite biproduct of one object P and every nonzero endomorphism of P is invertible, then the categorical radical is zero.
